text:
Jamie: Quick sync — we're proposing an identity consolidation for console metrics. Current problem: analytic events use mixed identity fields (user_id, route_owner, tenant_id, account_id). This breaks quota aggregates and dashboard joins.
Mira: +1. What's the target canonical field? tenant_id or a new metric_owner_id?
Jamie: Prefer metric_owner_id (stable, opaque UUID). Allows mapping multiple ids (user/account/route) to one owner for billing/quotas.
Sasha: Migration sketch: 1) add metric_owner_id column (nullable) 2) dual-write mapping in ingest service 3) backfill from historic joins 4) switch downstream reads to prefer metric_owner_id then fallback.
Owen: Backfill ops note — historic joins are heavy. Can we do staged backfill: recent 90d full, older sampled, then background catch-up? Cost estimate?
Mira: Staged backfill sounds good. We'll need a shadow index for the new column during migration to avoid full-table scans on dashboard queries.
lynne: UX/console impact — dashboards and quota pages must show both IDs during rollout with a tooltip explaining mapping. Also add a rollout toggle in console for customers to opt-in to strict owner semantics.
Sasha: API debate: should we expose metric_owner_id in public API now or keep internal until stable? My vote: internal-only for 2 sprints. Avoid customer-facing churn.
Jamie: Agreed internal-only first. Plan: feature-flag dual-write (ingest), add column, run shadow writes for 2 weeks, soft backfill (90d), enable read-pref in canary customers, monitor telemetry for discrepancy (>0.5% mismatch triggers rollback).
Owen: Can we add a lightweight invariant check: count(distinct metric_owner_id) vs count(distinct previous_owner_key) per route per hour. Add alert if ratio deviates >1.05.
Mira: I'll add the invariant metric to console telemetry and a per-route dashboard.
lynne: I'll draft the customer communication copy and the console toggle wording.
Sasha: Also: ensure quota engine uses metric_owner_id mapping before we cut over. Otherwise limits mischarged.
Jamie: Good catch. Add quota compatibility test to rollout checklist.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: ingest-dualwrite-shadow for 3100002200 -> 3100082200 :eyes:
Owen: Final ask — export a small sample of affected events for privacy review before backfill.
Jamie: Will do. Thanks everyone. I'll post the rollout checklist PR and tag infra + billing. :thumbsup:
